children.value: > Fact From Story: Structurally, Jubelirer has had some fun and games to contend with at CMG in her first two years in charge.

> > Fact From Story: One of Jubelirer’s most successful gambits, indie distribution/services company Caroline (later Virgin Music) was in recent years ‘spun out’ of CMG – forming a foundation for the global UMG priority venture that is today known as Virgin Music Group.
> > > Fact From Story: Motown was also ‘spun out’ of CMG, to become a standalone frontline label, in early 2021… before being ‘spun back’ into CMG at the top of this year.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Spinning a company out and then back in involves significant organizational and structural changes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Spinning out a company involves significant organizational and structural changes.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Managing structural changes can be difficult for a company.
